name: uberasm-vertical-parallax
title: Vertical Parallax
description:
This uberASM + Patch Combo creates an effect similar to HDMA parallax, but vertical.

In order to avoid sudden and glitchy movements, it is recommended to use a 1 screen long (check by pressing F1) repeated pattern.

You cannot scroll horizontally and layer 3 will be transparent due to how the ASM, and mode 2, work.

Special thanks to Xamexer for testing and Von Fahrenheit for helping me solve a few issues
